title: Rastelli 2025 · Experiment 1 · Classic tactile detection
citation: Rastelli, F., Ferroni, F., Langiulli, N., Crucianelli, L., Gallese, V., & Ardizzi, M. (2025). The spatial reach of affective touch: a new perspective on social peripersonal space. PsyArXiv, version 1.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.cohort: 35 participants completed the three explicitly numbered tasks in randomized order on one day.
published_method.carrier: 3 s looming sound. In the classic task, the pink-noise source is sampled at 44.1 kHz with an exponential level rise from 55 to 70 dB. The flat control is 62.5 dB.
published_method.analysis: Compare target reaction times across delays and estimate PSE. Collect separate verbal pleasantness ratings after the task.
published_method.tactile_target: Single 100 μs DS3 electrocutaneous pulse on the hairy right index finger, individually adjusted above detection threshold.
published_method.audio_setup: Two speakers about 100 cm apart; the near speaker sits about 10 cm from the right hand.
published_method.trial_schedule: Two blocks with 166 nominal trials. The six delays with 12 looming and six flat repeats give 108 paired trials. The separately printed paired percentage is 60%.
published_method.response: Press a key with the left index after touch. Ignore sounds and repeat missed targets.

source_provenance.value: Custom MATLAB presentation. Pink noise sampled at 44.1 kHz.
source_provenance.gap: No source waveform, code or exact sample generation identified.

trajectory_path.value: Apparent approach between two stationary speakers. Near speaker approximately 10 cm from right hand and far speaker 100 cm from near.

stimulus_speed.gap: No calibrated metric speed or distance by SOA reported.

gain_envelope.value: Looming overall intensity increases exponentially from 55 to 70 dB. Flat level is 62.5 dB.
gain_envelope.gap: Exact per-speaker envelope and calibration measurement location unreported.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two table speakers, Digitimer DS3, laptop and custom MATLAB presentation.

condition_intermixing.value: Target timings and sound conditions randomized, with catches intermingled.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Two equal blocks, approximately seven minutes per block.

response_window.gap: Online response cutoff and exact key identifier unreported.

task_sequence_rules.value: Press a laptop key with left index as soon as tactile target is detected. Ignore sound. Repeat missed tactile-target trials.

tactile_stimulus.gap: Device is constant current, but pulse description says constant voltage.

baseline_strategy.value: Tactile-only control delivered in leading silence.

catch_trial_type.value: Looming or flat sound without touch.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.gap: Six delays imply 108 paired trials, 65.06% of 166 versus stated 60%.

total_trial_count.gap: Trial-family split and handling of missed-target repetitions unavailable.

implementation_gaps: Recover the physical dual-speaker sound and calibrate synchronous electrocutaneous stimulation and key events.
Resolve how the 166-trial total, per-delay repeat counts, paired percentage, and baseline/catch quotas apply to the implemented blocks.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
